name: MetaDragon
fix_description: In _update, add return after super._update(from, to, value) when !isValidTokenId(value). Without it, ERC20 transfers to address(this) or erc721 will execute both the normal transfer AND the transform logic, causing double state modification.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward unrestricted minting case caused by a bad transfer condition, and the PoC is essentially just repeated token transfers to self-trigger minting followed by a swap to WBNB. It requires minimal protocol knowledge, no flash loans or complex cross-contract reasoning, and only a couple of external interactions.
